revision_reason: three corrections applied before any experimental result existed, approved 2026-09-15: (1) the YOLO arms trained on a linear learning-rate schedule while section 6 specifies cosine and the torchvision arms implemented cosine; cos_lr is now set explicitly. (2) the section 4 secondary metrics - precision and recall at the F1-maximal operating point selected on the validation arm - were never computed, and the validation arm was never read; they are now computed, and checkpoints and raw predictions are persisted for all four architectures so they can be audited without retraining. (3) the four models predicted under three different library inference configurations, which depressed the two torchvision arms on a ranking comparison; one architecture-independent evaluation policy now applies to all four, chosen from measured corpus properties. The replicate count was also restored from 3 to 5 for P1, P2 and P3, giving 19 partitions and 76 runs, because the split-noise floor of section 7 is defined on 5 P1 replicates and is anti-conservative when estimated from 3.
